topic: Introduction to roles of Air Arm of the Indian Navy
syllabus_extract: Introduction to roles of Air Arm of the Indian Navy.
specific_objectives: 25.1.1.1 Trainee will be able to enumerate roles of Air Arm of the Indian Navy and introduce about IN aircrafts, its roles and operating squadrons/ flights.

practical: Review of syllabus objectives and verification of trainee attendance
intro_questions: What is the primary function of the Indian Navy?
Can you name one major naval air base in India?
What is the general purpose of naval aviation?

topics: Historical evolution of Indian Naval Aviation
Integration with land and sea forces
development.content:
Historical evolution of Indian Naval Aviation
Strategic importance of Air Arm
Core operational roles defined
Integration with land and sea forces
Future modernization goals

Maritime Reconnaissance and Surveillance
Anti-Submarine Warfare (ASW)
Anti-Surface Warfare (ASuW)
Air Defense and Interdiction
Search and Rescue Operations

Introduction to IN Aircraft Types
Fixed-wing vs Rotary-wing platforms
Key squadrons and flight locations
Roles of specific aircraft classes
Operational readiness standards

summary_questions: Enumerate the five primary roles of the Indian Navy Air Arm.
Explain how the Air Arm supports surface fleet operations.
Identify the difference between ASW and ASuW roles.
home_assignment_question: Prepare a brief note on the specific roles and locations of two major squadrons operating in the Western and Eastern Commands to be discussed in LP 02.
